facts.statement: The company has in place a Directors and Officers Liability Insurance policy, the adequacy and quantum of which are reviewed annually by the Board.
facts.quote: In accordance with the requirements of Regulation  25(10) of the Listing Regulations, the Company has  in place, a Directors and Officers Liability Insurance  ("D&O Insurance") policy. The Board reviews the  adequacy and quantum of the D&O Insurance on an  annual basis.
